{{Quote|[The Sith] dwelled close to the five major places where they performed their Mysteries. Each settlement was located near an elaborate lava cave system that had a specific focus...|[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Natua Wan]], [[44 ABY]]|<ref name="FotJ:A">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mysteries''' were a series of ancient [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith rituals]] and [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] initiations that were conducted on the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith World]] of [[Upekzar]] at five sacred volcanic cave systems that together constituted the [[Circle of Visions]]. These rituals and their associated sites individually dealt with different focuses and disparate aspects of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], but universally made use of the [[rhak-skuri]], a subspecies of [[diplura]] whose members produced [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]] known to cause nightmare-like hallucinations among certain [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species.<ref name="FotJ:A" />

The more noteworthy among the five Mysteries were the [[High Rites]], conducted by the strongest [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]] at an [[High Rites cave system|elaborate cave system]] in the temperate region of Upekzar; the [[Cold Rites]], where practitioners tempered emotions and hardened their hearts; and the [[Rites of Fire]], where acolytes focused their anger and passions into greater control over the dark side.<ref name="FotJ:A" />
